author: EyMoose
body:
My minecraft user name is izjust4haxM81v1
Yesterday April 2nd I was banned for hacking/kill aura as said on my profile.
I believe I should be unbanned as I do not believe I was hacking at the time. I know the server was lagging real hard and I got a kill streak on very popular players that I usually never get kills on. I believe hacking is cheating and is a very bad thing to do and I do not do it because of that. If someone can tell me what exactly is kill aura, that will also be greatly appriciated. If you still think I was hacking, then it is your right to keep me banned. I am just appealing as I was not hacking and I would like to play again on its many gametypes. If a temp ban is needed I am ok with that, but I do not believe I was hacking and needed to be banned.

Thank you for taking my appeal in to consideration,
iz

replies.author: hpux
replies.body:
Hello,

Unfortunately, your punishment will remain valid. You were using very, very blatant hacks, and I'm not very impressed that you're denying it. You will need to stay banned a significant amount of time for your appeal to be considered.

Regards,

Peacheh, Avicus Network Administrator.
